// FIXTURE — Swift-shaped source containing ONLY endpoints that appear in
// scripts/todoist-allowed-endpoints.txt. scripts/tests/run-script-tests.sh
// copies this into a temporary directory as a .swift file and runs
// check-todoist-writes.sh against it, expecting exit code 0.
//
// This is a fixture, not compiled code. It lives outside the app's source glob
// and is never part of any target.
//
// It covers the three shapes a real call site takes:
//   1. a base-URL constant, which normalises to the bare API root
//   2. a short path appended to that base
//   3. a path with an interpolated identifier, which normalises to {id}

let todoistAPIBase = URL(string: "https://api.todoist.com/api/v1")

let projectsPath = "/projects"
let sectionsPath = "/sections"
let tasksPath = "/tasks"

// The one and only permitted write: completing a task.
let closePath = "/tasks/\(taskID)/close"

// The same call written out in full, to prove both forms normalise alike.
let fullCloseURL = "https://api.todoist.com/api/v1/tasks/\(taskID)/close"
